narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL3__M1F8BAA4 reveals significant opportunity for cost reduction and service improvement.

DEMAND PROFILE: The material exhibits highly_erratic demand with a mean daily demand of 499.62 units and CV of 0.626. 
The demand pattern is Normal-like with 93.9% of days having non-zero demand. 
No significant trend detected.

LEAD TIME CHARACTERISTICS: Lead time is unstable with mean 1.13 days (CV=0.799). 
The dominant source of lead time variability is transport (50.0% of variance).

OPTIMIZATION RESULTS: The analysis recommends increasing safety stock from 0 to 920 units 
and order quantity from 357 (MOQ) to 3941 units. This change will reduce annual costs from 
$26,452.79 to $5,812.58, achieving savings of $20,640.21 (78.0%).

The optimized policy balances ordering frequency (31.7 orders/year vs 349.9 currently) 
with inventory holding costs while maintaining 95% service level.

Storage capacity is fully utilized at 100.0%.
warnings: High demand variability detected - consider demand forecasting improvement
Unstable lead time - consider supplier performance improvement
Storage capacity highly utilized (>95%) - monitor closely
